standing: presentation baseline only — craft continuity, never semantic truth
family: episteme etymology whole-fields (6 WHOLE-FIELD.md records), carried in roz-etymologies
lineage_chain: O:I global → Epi global → roz-corpus-base → family-etymology-whole (this file) → record variant → scene override
attitude: a whole-field is a generated relation, not a dictionary entry: one centre, one envelope, six operation stations — the six generated relations of the field; evidence registers stay distinct in the card, never collapsed into one descent claim

entities.centre: one disc — the field's centre relation
entities.operations: six small discs at hexagon stations — the six generated operations (the canonical N / N′ → N+N′ shape; e.g. E2's 6 / 6′ generating six earned relations)
entities.entity_ceiling: never more than 10 formations per scene (native limit; 8 is this family's max)

text_layers.editorial_card: kicker '<record_id> · <CLAIM_STATUS uppercase>' (etymology-symbol-account-and-trust declares no claim_status; its kicker carries the id alone) · title · italic = field id (where declared) + declared source_relation + the register discipline note
text_layers.body: the whole-field claim (#0 opening), compressed from the record only

variation_rules: one grammar for all six wholes — the source form itself repeats (whole-field with six positions)
historical descent, attested sense, operational homology and poetic re-entry stay text-layer distinctions; the field formation never asserts a descent claim
